answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Every claim climbs the atlas of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the horizon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The gale of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
